_doc: Machine-wide runtime switches. No credentials. CLI and dashboard preserve other sections.

typesafe._doc: mode: off = no calls; shadow = observe advice, the agent decides; active = follow choices at or above min_confidence within existing rules.
typesafe._doc_enforce_decisions: Require decision records at covered native execution seams; internal judgments use harness decision explicitly.
typesafe._doc_decision_ttl_seconds: Reuse only unchanged decision states within this many seconds; consumed action receipts remain single-use.
typesafe._doc_checkpoints: Enable automatic phase/session checkpoints; required checks always remain enforced.
typesafe._doc_min_confidence: Accept Jev choices at or above this confidence; otherwise escalate to agent reasoning.

dispatch._doc: Enable role-scoped dispatch. False keeps execution with the parent and prevents new worker launches.
dispatch._doc_max_workers: Maximum simultaneous native and external workers per run.
dispatch._doc_max_context_bytes: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in each worker's role packet; do not include full conversation history.
dispatch._doc_timeout_seconds: Stop timed-out external processes and require native parent cancellation at this deadline.
dispatch._doc_profiles: Eligible role/model/backend combinations. Native needs parent tools; command providers use operator-configured argv only; amp providers also need amp.enabled.

telemetry._doc: Dashboard collection only; does not enable TypeSafe or dispatch. Unavailable service queues events locally.
telemetry._doc_jev: Collect decision, routing and agent measurements.
telemetry._doc_workflow: Collect session, task, todo and tool lifecycle events.
telemetry._doc_workflow_prompts: Store full future user prompts; requires workflow collection. Saved history is retained.

amp._doc: Run dispatch workers in Amp orb threads (amp -ox). On: every worker is offered an orb first and falls back to its listed profiles when an orb cannot take it. Off: no orb is started.
amp._doc_effort: Effort for orb workers (low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra); it picks the Amp mode.
amp._doc_poll_seconds: Seconds between thread export checks while an orb worker runs.

sites._doc: Firebrik Sites publishing for every agent (harness sites). The token stays in token_file (0600), never here.
sites._doc_url: Sites host; its MCP endpoint is URL/mcp/sites.
sites._doc_token_file: File holding a personal API token from Settings > API tokens; FIREBRIK_SITES_TOKEN overrides it.
